front_end: original (research repo ttc/segment.py: white balance, chroma + GrabCut outline, lumen excluded), GrabCut seeded per slice; real holes from the shared hole model removed
a_star: scikit-image CIELAB a* of the white-balanced photo, Gaussian blur sigma 1.5

recipe.conservative: a* cut on a grid 4.0-22.0 step 0.25 with the smallest mean absolute error of slice infarct % vs YHS on the time-control slices; accuracy reported leave one heart out
recipe.liberal: valley of a 2-component GMM on a* pooled from all 30 slices (5,000 px per slice, seed 42)

pass_rule: shared front end if time-control MAE vs YHS <= 2.9 pp, else the original front end
